dedupe_keys.name: openadb satellite altimetry and sea level products

description: The Open Altimeter Database at DGFI-TUM distributes harmonized along-track satellite-altimetry measurements and derived sea-surface products. Its public pages list sea-surface height, sea-level anomaly, dynamic ocean topography and ocean-tide products from multiple missions. Registered users can select a product, mission, time interval and area; extracted values are supplied as NetCDF files by mission, cycle and pass. The registration page states CC BY 3.0 for OpenADB datasets. These observations can inform coastal sea-level and storm-surge boundary conditions for ports and flood-defence studies. The portal emphasizes ocean products; it should not be assumed to provide a ready-made inland-water level series or a gridded flood map. Cross-mission calibration helps comparison, but users must check product versions, corrections and mission sampling. The service complements data-ipcc-ar6-sea-level-projections with observed tracks, not future projections. No account was created and no extract was downloaded. Global coverage varies by mission. The observations are inputs for coastal flood-risk simulations.
